criteria.name: Empirical fNIRS study
criteria.pass_if: The record reports original collection and/or analysis of (f)NIRS data.
criteria.fail_if: The record is a review, meta-analysis, or commentary with no original (f)NIRS data of its own.
criteria.uncertain_if: The abstract does not make clear whether (f)NIRS data were collected or analysed.

criteria.name: Quality control reported
criteria.pass_if: The paper describes at least one signal- or data-quality procedure, such as a quantitative metric (CV, SCI, SQI, GVTD), visual inspection, or channel rejection.
criteria.fail_if: The paper reports no quality-control step anywhere in the methods.
criteria.uncertain_if: Preprocessing is mentioned only in general terms, with no identifiable quality-control step.
